notes.title: How The Outer Worlds 2 Was Made For The RPG Lover
notes.notes:
After being perhaps best known for developing sequels for licensed properties such as Star Wars, Neverwinter Nights and Fallout, leadership at California-based Obsidian Entertainment decided, in early 2016, that it was time for a new RPG set in their own original world. They decided that the best person to helm such a project would be Tim Cain, who joined the company in 2011 and was one of the two creators of the Fallout series. Cain then himself invited Leonard Boyarsky, with whom he created Fallout, to embark on developing what eventually became the space RPG The Outer Worlds, released in 2019. The game was generally well received, even though some criticized the short length of the campaign and lacklustre player decisions.

A sequel, The Outer Worlds 2, was announced in 2021, but it was this year that things, including the release date of 29 October 2025, finally started falling into place. During gamescom 2025, I not only got the chance to go hands-on with the game for a full... Read more

notes.title: Xbox Does 180 on The Outer Worlds 2’s $80 Release By Reducing it and Reimbursing Pre-Orders
notes.notes:
After the initial announcement that The Outer Worlds 2 would be $80 fans levied blame on Xbox, but today, they’ve had a change of heart.

After months of fan backlash facing video game base pricing, it appears the overlords who make that game pricing have decided to go back on their word (in a good way) and reduce the price back down. The problems started when The Outer Worlds 2 direct happened in June, and at the end, the sequel was revealed to a new game price point of $80. That doesn’t just cover The Outer Worlds 2. Xbox has confirmed that all of its titles will remain at $70 for the foreseeable future, as stated in a recent announcement to IGN.

At that time, Xbox stated that the decision to price the title at $80 was based on “market conditions and the rising cost of development,” and fans were not pleased with the revelation. notes.title: The Outer Worlds 2 Launches October 29, 2025 – Pre-Orders Now Live
notes.notes: [h3][b]If you thought Halcyon was bad, just wait until you visit Arcadia.[/b][/h3][p]Cut off from Earth, you arrive as an Earth Directorate agent with a mission. How you carry it out—who you help, hinder, or exploit—is up to you. Build your character with dynamic traits, flaws, and backgrounds that shape every decision and unlock new ways to fight, sneak, persuade, or just blow things up.[/p][p]Arcadia isn’t just bigger. It’s meaner, messier, and more reactive. And the only thing standing between it and collapse? You. Probably.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Pick a Side. Or Don’t.[/b][/h3][p]Three factions dominate Arcadia, each with wildly different visions for humanity’s future:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Protectorate[/b]: A military regime powered by endless resources that believes people are happiest when they don’t have to think for themselves. Order is peace. Obedience is comfort. Truly loved by all loyal citizens -- just ask them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auntie’s Choice[/b]: The loud, smiling merger of Auntie Cleo’s and Spacer’s Choice. They promise freedom, fulfillment, and a future where your only real choice is which Auntie’s product you’ll need next.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Order of the Ascendant[/b]: Rogue scientists turned faith-based futurists, determined to perfect humanity by solving the Universal Equation. They worship patterns, predict the future through math, and perform rituals in labs with terrifying precision all in service of a better tomorrow.[/p][/*][/list][p]Factions clash in real-time. Towns change hands. Radio stations shift tone. Your choices ripple across Arcadia—and thanks to its ever-present radio system, you won’t just hear the news. You [i]are[/i] the news. Folk hero or public enemy? Depends on who's spinning it (and selling you a health tonic).[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Build Your Hero (or Disaster)[/b][/h3][p]RPG systems have been reimagined with more freedom and flavor. Traits and flaws evolve based on your playstyle—steal enough and you might become a Kleptomaniac, boosting loot sales but risking “accidental” theft just by looking.[/p][p]Science weapons return, including the Shrink Ray—now with the added bonus of letting you stomp your enemies once bite-sized. Also, yes: there’s a wearable suit made from something that used to be alive. His name is Gary.[/p][p]Movement and combat feel better across the board. Dash, leap, and parkour your way through the chaos—or swap to third person and enjoy the view.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Your Crew, Your Consequences[/b][/h3][p]Travel with six companions, each with a stake in Arcadia’s future—and opinions about your decisions. One might plead for mercy, another might suggest vaporizing a town. Sacrifice a companion to survive and you’ll hear about it. On the radio. From the faction you betrayed.[/p][p]Your crew includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Niles[/b]: Another Earth Directorate recruit torn between duty and defection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inez[/b]: A former experiment from Auntie’s Choice with a grafted combat edge and a moral core.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aza[/b]: A chaos-loving Rift worshipper with a taste for violence and room to grow—maybe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Marisol[/b]: A stoic killer from the Order of the Ascendant with calculations to settle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tristen[/b]: A walking tank and judge from the Protectorate, looking to dispense justice -- or redefine it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Valerie[/b]: A floating, chirping support unit with unexpected upgrades and untapped potential.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Coming October 29, 2025[/b][/h3][p][i]The Outer Worlds 2[/i] launches October 29, 2025—pre-order now and explore Arcadia your way.[/p][p]All pre-orders include the [b]Commander Zane Pack[/b], with a Zane-themed armor skin, helmet, signature pistol and dagger, and an Earth Directorate drone companion pet.[/p][p]Arcadia may be falling apart—but there’s never been a better time to show up, suit up, and sign up for something you probably won’t regret.[/p][p][i]Probably.[/i][/p]

It has been an absolute whirlwind of news, previews, world premieres and new gameplay reveals during the weekend of Summer Game Fest 2025. New looks were given to titles like Grounded 2, Ninja Gaiden IV, and even a new Call of Duty was announced, however, Obsidian Entertainment followed the Xbox Games Showcase 2025 with their very own The Outer Worlds 2 Direct. The teaser trailer presented at the Xbox Games Showcase 2025 presentation can be seen in full below, and a written breakdown of the direct follows.

notes.title: Xbox Games Showcase 2025 Is Coming June 8 — With The Outer Worlds 2 Direct Right After
notes.notes:
Xbox has announced that the Xbox Games Showcase 2025 will be held on June 8, 2025, followed by The Outer Worlds 2 Direct.

It has already been an exciting year for gamers, and Xbox is set to continue the momentum with its upcoming showcase, which will highlight titles from its first-party studios as well as new third-party releases. Immediately following the main presentation, fans can tune in for The Outer Worlds 2 Direct, a dedicated feature focused on Obsidian Entertainment’s highly anticipated sequel.

The Xbox Games Showcase 2025 will be a digital-only broadcast, streaming on YouTube, Twitch and Facebook on June 8 at 10 a.m. PDT / 1 p.m. EDT / 6 p.m. BST / 7 p.m. CET. Viewers in Japan and Australia can tune in on June 9 at 2 a.m. JST and 3 a.m. AEST. While the list of featured titles has not been confirmed, fans are hopeful for updates on DOOM: The Dark Ages and The Elder Scrolls VI, which was originally announced in 2018.

notes.title: The Outer Worlds 2 Featuring More Action, More Weapons, and More Graphics!
notes.notes:
The call to venture beyond the stars has returned, and this time, it’s bigger, bolder, and more unpredictable than ever. During The Game Awards 2024, we unveiled the first gameplay trailer for The Outer Worlds 2, promising a fresh adventure in a brand-new colony next year. No, really. The colony is completely new, and that’s a fact. Just, please—don’t break it. Yes, we’re looking at you, Hope-sun-launchers.
True to Obsidian Entertainment’s signature style, The Outer Worlds 2 lets you carve your path through Arcadia, a colony brimming with factions, intrigue, and chaos. This is the birthplace of skip-drive technology and the battleground where the fate of the galaxy hangs in the balance. As a daring, undeniably good-looking, and maybe-questionably-competent Earth Directorate agent, you’re tasked with uncovering the source of catastrophic rifts threatening everything. No pressure. How you handle these rifts? That’s entirely up to you—“Your worlds, your way,” after all.

Wishlist the game today and stay tuned for more updates on The Outer Worlds 2—we can’t wait to share what’s next with you. The galaxy is yours to explore; the only question is, how will you shape it? The Outer Worlds 2 will be released in 2025.
